name: fullstack-auth-module
description: One npm workspace: the shared API contract in contract/, the apps in backend/ and frontend/, the browser journeys in e2e/.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm run build -w contract
scripts.dev: npm run build -w contract && concurrently --names contract,backend,frontend --prefix-colors yellow,blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w contract" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w contract && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w e2e
scripts.test: npm run build -w contract && npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w contract && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w contract && npm test -w e2e
